moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City on Friday night.

angles.name: Opening Night Buzz
angles.copy: Premier League is BACK! Arsenal kick off the 2026/27 season against Frank Lampard's Coventry City on Friday night. Who's winning the opener?

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: After a long summer, the Premier League returns this Friday! New managers, new transfers, new dreams. What are your predictions for the season?

moments.title: Premier League Opening Weekend
moments.blurb: Matchday 1 of the Premier League continues with Hull City vs Manchester United on Saturday and Newcastle United vs Liverpool on Sunday.

angles.name: Saturday Showdown
angles.copy: It's a big Saturday in the Premier League! Hull City host Manchester United. Can the Tigers cause an upset on their top-flight return?

angles.name: Super Sunday Clash
angles.copy: Sunday brings a massive clash as Newcastle United take on Liverpool. Who's got the edge in this early season blockbuster?

moments.title: Ariana Grande London Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande continues her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at The O2 in London with multiple dates this week.

angles.name: O2 Takeover
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is owning The O2 this week! If you're heading to one of her 'Eternal Sunshine' shows, get ready for an incredible night!

angles.name: Eternal Sunshine Live
angles.copy: With multiple dates at London's O2, Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' is the hottest ticket in town. What's your favourite track from the album to hear live?

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' to Wembley Stadium in London for a final UK show today.

angles.name: Wembley Finale
angles.copy: The Weeknd is at Wembley Stadium tonight for the final UK date of his 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour'. Expect a spectacular show!

angles.name: After Hours Party
angles.copy: If you're heading to see The Weeknd at Wembley tonight, get ready to sing along to all the hits under the stars! Which track are you most excited for?

moments.title: Hollywood Vampires in Birmingham
moments.blurb: The supergroup Hollywood Vampires, featuring Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp, and Joe Perry, perform in Birmingham tonight.

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp, Joe Perry... Hollywood Vampires are bringing their rock spectacle to Birmingham tonight! Who's going?

angles.name: Star-studded Stage
angles.copy: It's not every day you get this much rock 'n' roll star power on one stage! Hollywood Vampires live in Birmingham tonight!

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating diverse music, wellness, and culture, kicks off tomorrow in Dorset and is sold out.

angles.name: Dorset Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival starts tomorrow! Four days of incredible music, wellness, and good vibes in Dorset. Who's got tickets to this sold-out event?

angles.name: Gilles Peterson Curates
angles.copy: Curated by the legendary Gilles Peterson, We Out Here is a true celebration of genre-hopping music. Get ready for a diverse lineup!

moments.title: All Points East Starts
moments.blurb: The All Points East festival returns to Victoria Park, London, starting Friday for two weekends of music.

angles.name: London's Festival
angles.copy: All Points East kicks off Friday in Victoria Park! London's massive festival is back for another year of huge headliners and unforgettable sets. Who are you seeing?

angles.name: Victoria Park Vibes
angles.copy: Get ready for festival season in the capital! All Points East brings the noise to Victoria Park this weekend and next. Sun's out, tunes are on!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Approaching
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds Festivals are set to take place next weekend, August 28-30.

angles.name: Countdown to R&L
angles.copy: Only one week until Reading & Leeds Festivals! Who's packing their wellies and getting ready for the biggest weekend of the summer?

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is just around the corner! From rock anthems to chart-topping hits, which acts are you most excited to catch next weekend?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot on the Official Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In' for the week ending August 19, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: They've done it again! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still number one with 'Rein Me In'. Is it your favourite track right now?

angles.name: Weekend Anthems
angles.copy: Still riding high at #1! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is the sound of the week. What's your go-to weekend anthem?

moments.title: New Chart Entry: Madonna & Kylie
moments.blurb: Madonna and Kylie Minogue enter the Official Singles Chart at #8 this week with their collaboration 'Love Sensation'.

angles.name: Pop Royalty Collab
angles.copy: A legendary team-up! Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is a brand new entry in the Official Singles Chart Top 10. What a duo!

angles.name: Fresh Music Friday
angles.copy: New music from two icons hitting the charts! Madonna and Kylie Minogue prove why they're still queens with 'Love Sensation' at #8. Have you heard it yet?

moments.title: Ian Gillan (Deep Purple) Turns 81
moments.blurb: Deep Purple frontman Ian Gillan, known for his powerful vocals on tracks like 'Smoke on the Water', is 81 today.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the legendary voice of Deep Purple, Ian Gillan! What's your favourite Deep Purple track?

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: From 'Smoke on the Water' to 'Child in Time', Ian Gillan's vocals defined an era. Happy 81st birthday to a true rock icon!

moments.title: John Deacon (Queen) Turns 75
moments.blurb: John Deacon, the legendary bassist and songwriter for Queen, responsible for hits like 'Another One Bites the Dust', is 75 today.

angles.name: Queen's Bassist
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible John Deacon of Queen! He gave us some of the band's most iconic basslines and songs. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Another One Bites The Dust
angles.copy: The quiet genius behind some of Queen's biggest hits turns 75 today! Raise a glass to John Deacon!

moments.title: Robert Plant (Led Zeppelin) Turns 78
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant, whose distinctive voice shaped rock music, celebrates his 78th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Golden God
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the iconic voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant, turns 78! What's your ultimate Plant vocal moment?

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate a rock legend! Robert Plant's 78th birthday is tomorrow. Which Led Zeppelin track defines him for you?

moments.title: Liam Howlett (The Prodigy) Turns 55
moments.blurb: Liam Howlett, the mastermind and instrumentalist behind electronic pioneers The Prodigy, celebrates his 55th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Prodigy Pioneer
angles.copy: Firestarter! Liam Howlett of The Prodigy turns 55 on Friday. His groundbreaking sound changed the game. What's your favourite Prodigy anthem?

angles.name: Electronic Visionary
angles.copy: Wishing a future happy birthday to Liam Howlett! The man behind The Prodigy's iconic beats celebrates 55 years this Friday. Keep on raving!

moments.title: Kelis Turns 46
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', celebrates her 46th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Milkshake Maker
angles.copy: Kelis turns 46 this Friday! From 'Caught Out There' to 'Milkshake', she's given us so many unforgettable tracks. Which one is your favourite?

angles.name: R&B Icon
angles.copy: Happy almost birthday to the one and only Kelis! She's been serving up hits for decades. Get ready to celebrate her 46th on Friday!

moments.title: Billy Ray Cyrus Turns 65
moments.blurb: Country music superstar Billy Ray Cyrus, famed for 'Achy Breaky Heart' and his acting career, celebrates his 65th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Achy Breaky Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to line dance! Billy Ray Cyrus turns 65 this Monday. What's your favourite track from the country legend?

angles.name: Country Icon
angles.copy: From global hits to family fame, Billy Ray Cyrus has done it all! Happy 65th birthday for Monday to a true music icon.

moments.title: Gene Simmons (KISS) Turns 77
moments.blurb: KISS bassist and co-founder Gene Simmons, the 'Demon' of rock, will celebrate his 77th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Rock Demon's Birthday
angles.copy: The Demon turns 77! Gene Simmons of KISS celebrates his birthday this Monday. What's your favourite KISS anthem?

angles.name: KISS Legend
angles.copy: Legendary bassist and showman Gene Simmons is 77 on Monday! Get ready to rock and roll all night (and party every day) in his honour!

moments.title: Amy Macdonald Turns 38
moments.blurb: Scottish singer-songwriter Amy Macdonald, known for 'This Is the Life', celebrates her 38th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Scottish Star
angles.copy: Happy 38th birthday for Monday to the brilliant Amy Macdonald! 'This Is the Life' and so many other great tracks. What's your favourite?

angles.name: This Is The Life
angles.copy: Celebrating Amy Macdonald's 38th birthday this Monday! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have captivated fans worldwide.

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31, creating a long weekend.

angles.name: Long Weekend Ahead
angles.copy: That's right, the Summer Bank Holiday is just around the corner! August 31st means a three-day weekend for most of the UK. How are you spending yours?

angles.name: End of Summer Plans
angles.copy: The final Bank Holiday of summer is coming up on August 31st! Make the most of it – sunshine (hopefully!) and good times await.
